decisions.reason: As a newly launched dental product line with its own webpage, it reflects visible commitment and likely dedicated investment, so management would be inclined to continue despite any early uncertainty.
This thermoforming blank fits the firm's materials and laboratory workflow business and was given its own page, making withdrawal after only a year relatively unlikely.

The UV-curing lacquer appears less prominently committed than the core launches, but because it is still new and complementary to the firm's manufacturing portfolio, management would more likely persist for now.
The intraoral contrast spray was presented on its own page and supports digital clinical workflows, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit both favor keeping it on the market.

Although only mentioned on the website, this is a multi-model custom earmold line in a customer segment the firm already serves, so prior development effort and portfolio fit make continuation more likely than exit.

This hearing-protection earmold line is closely related to the firm's custom hearing-care capabilities, and even with lower public visibility the firm would likely continue rather than quickly reverse course.
